note: How much a man has to mind before he writes. The director's section 4: pressure is about the world and the threshold is about the man. Base is per role - a governor reports often and the Chancellor almost never. Redundancy raises it for each further contact of a role, which is the only volume control that scales with a colony - but only for roles the colony accumulates. The Crown's officers share one role and are four distinct offices that do different work, so a fourth of them is not a third clergyman. All of it is tuning.
